verses.english: Numbered Discourses 3.132
13. Kusinārā
Etchings
“Mendicants, these three individuals are found in the world.
What three?

verses.pali: Pāsāṇalekhūpamo puggalo, pathavilekhūpamo puggalo, udakalekhūpamo puggalo.
verses.english: An individual like a line drawn in stone, an individual like a line drawn in sand, and an individual like a line drawn in water.
And who is the individual like a line drawn in stone?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṁ kujjhati.
verses.english: It’s an individual who is often angry,

verses.pali: So ca khvassa kodho dīgharattaṁ anuseti.
verses.english: and their anger lingers for a long time.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, pāsāṇe lekhā na khippaṁ lujjati vātena vā udakena vā, ciraṭṭhitikā hoti;
verses.english: It’s like a line drawn in stone, which isn’t quickly worn away by wind and water, but lasts for a long time.

verses.pali: evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, idhekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṁ kujjhati.
verses.english: In the same way, an individual is often angry,

verses.pali: So ca khvassa kodho dīgharattaṁ anuseti.
verses.english: and their anger lingers for a long time.
This is called an individual like a line drawn in stone.
And who is the individual like a line drawn in sand?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṁ kujjhati.
verses.english: It’s an individual who is often angry,

verses.pali: So ca khvassa kodho na dīgharattaṁ anuseti.
verses.english: but their anger doesn’t linger long.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, pathaviyā lekhā khippaṁ lujjati vātena vā udakena vā, na ciraṭṭhitikā hoti;
verses.english: It’s like a line drawn in sand, which is quickly worn away by wind and water, and doesn’t last long.

verses.pali: evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, idhekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṁ kujjhati.
verses.english: In the same way, an individual is often angry,

verses.pali: So ca khvassa kodho na dīgharattaṁ anuseti.
verses.english: but their anger doesn’t linger long.
This is called an individual like a line drawn in sand.
And who is the individual like a line drawn in water?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo āgāḷhenapi vuccamāno pharusenapi vuccamāno amanāpenapi vuccamāno sandhiyatimeva saṁsandatimeva sammodatimeva.
verses.english: It’s an individual who, though spoken to by someone in a rough, harsh, and disagreeable manner, still stays in touch, interacts with, and greets them.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, udake lekhā khippaṁyeva paṭivigacchati, na ciraṭṭhitikā hoti;
verses.english: It’s like a line drawn in water, which vanishes right away, and doesn’t last long.

verses.pali: evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, idhekacco puggalo āgāḷhenapi vuccamāno pharusenapi vuccamāno amanāpenapi vuccamāno sandhiyatimeva saṁsandatimeva sammodatimeva.
verses.english: In the same way, an individual, though spoken to by someone in a rough, harsh, and disagreeable manner, still stays in touch, interacts with, and greets them.
This is called an individual like a line drawn in water.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmin”ti.
verses.english: These are the three individuals found in the world.”
